<h1 class="slot-title">From fragments<br>to one shared<br>story</h1>
<p class="slot-context">02</p>
<p class="slot-orientation">A visible sequence turns useful mess<br>into a direction people can improve together.</p>

---

<!-- _class: archetype-text-only variation-default tone-light -->

<h2 class="slot-heading">Clarity is a sequence,<br>not a spark</h2>
<p class="slot-label">Five moves</p>
<div class="slot-body"><ol>
<li>Collect the useful mess<br>before narrowing.</li>
<li>Name the audience decision<br>that matters.</li>
<li>Arrange evidence around<br>one narrative spine.</li>
<li>Test whether every slide<br>earns its place.</li>
<li>Refine language until<br>the direction is obvious.</li>
</ol></div>

<!--
- Walk through the five moves in order. Each one narrows the story.
- Pause on the audience decision; it anchors every later slide.
-->

---

<!-- _class: archetype-text-plus-image variation-portrait tone-light -->

<h2 class="slot-heading">Make the reasoning<br>visible</h2>
<div class="slot-body"><ul>
<li>Externalize incomplete<br>ideas early.</li>
<li>Keep the central subject<br>clearly protected.</li>
<li>Use feedback to sharpen<br>the shared model.</li>
<li>Preserve intent while<br>changing presentation.</li>
</ul></div>
<figure class="slot-media"><img src="media/portrait.svg" alt="A protected portrait fixture representing a collaborator shaping an idea"></figure>
<p class="slot-caption">Portrait media selects the portrait composition<br>without changing the slide’s semantic role.</p>
